item.title: Update of Hartford’s underground loop heating system on hold
item.description: A contentious plan to continue heating state office buildings in downtown Hartford with a new generation of gas-powered boilers is on hold.

item.title: EPA plan would roll back ‘good neighbor’ rule on downwind pollution
item.description: The Trump administration took a step toward rolling back a rule limiting smokestack emissions that hit downwind areas in neighboring states.

item.title: Sen. Susan Collins says ICE to end Maine operation after more than 200 arrests
item.description: Collins, a Republican, announced the development after saying she had spoken directly with Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem.

item.title: During Muslim Heritage Month, a new welcoming space is created
item.description: The Crescent Ball was meant as a safe space to exist, share a meal, listen to music, spoken word, and meet other CT Muslims.

item.title: CBIA spotlights affordability, workforce ahead of legislative session
item.description: Connecticut’s largest business association laid out a policy agenda Thursday that addresses the needs of the state’s small businesses.

item.title: Lamont, lawmakers to extend CT fund to counter federal cutbacks
item.description: CT still has $330 million to supplement programs affected by Washington’s cuts to human services. The money will be available until July.

item.title: Fairfield announces, then abruptly cancels, school visit by Linda McMahon
item.description: Hours after announcing a visit by US Education Secretary Linda McMahon, Fairfield Public Schools canceled the event due to community backlash

item.title: New details emerge on faked DCF call in ‘Mimi’ Torres-García case
item.description: A 10-year veteran at DCF met with a 21-year-old woman she believed to be Jacqueline 'Mimi' Torres-García, court testimony revealed.

item.title: Why my daughter’s rare genetic disorder is CT’s moral imperative
item.description: The crisis facing rare disease and disability families in CT is caused by systemic underinvestment, administrative barriers, and policy choices.

item.title: School boards need an open-government refresher
item.description: Many CT school boards have stopped doing written evaluations of superintendents. Instead conducting oral evaluations. In secret. In executive session.
